source_policy.zh-CN: Recent community translation of JP content; use as semantic bridge, not canonical spelling authority for proper nouns.

world_facts: Uma Musume are humanlike athletes inspired by racehorses, not literal horses in ordinary horse racing.
Tracen Academy is the central academy/training institution.
Trainers guide Uma Musume through training, races and career progression.
Racing, training, character stories and Winning Live are distinct game contexts.
